Trump to meet Anthropic CEO amid AI safety concerns

President Donald Trump is scheduled to have dinner with Anthropic Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei on Sunday. The meeting is notable as Amodei and Trump are reportedly at opposite ends of the artificial intelligence safety debate. Trump has previously dismissed AI fears, while Amodei's company, Anthropic, is focused on AI safety. The meeting comes after Amodei missed a state dinner. Separately, Trump held a call with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to discuss trade talks and India-US ties.
